title: Effect template literal validation can block the event loop
summary: Schema.TemplateLiteral patterns with multiple string spans compile into ambiguous regex wildcards. Non-matching untrusted input can cause cubic backtracking during decoding.

severity.rationale: The flaw causes denial of service during schema validation, including RPC and HTTP payloads. The affected schema shape must be used.

exposure: Applications must decode untrusted input against a template containing two or more Schema.String spans.

params.instructions: Check effect version, affected release line and the documented exposure conditions.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade to 3.22.1. If delayed, bound input before template decoding; adding maxLength after decoding does not prevent the expensive regex.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed release meets the corresponding fixed version and verify the affected workflow with harmless test inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
